name: Törggelette – Tiroler Spielefest
beschreibung:
=== description ===

Traditional games like *Törggele*, nail-hammering (*Nagelschlagen*), sack jumping (*Sackhüpfen*), and many others await both big and little guests at the Tiroler Spielefest. Alongside, there are children’s face painting (*Kinderschminken*), roasted bread (*Stockbrot*), and plenty of fun on the alpine meadows of the Tannheimer Tal. A vibrant family day filled with regional refreshments.
